description:
Seven Servers is a Detroit father-and-son space technology team founded by Preston Eaton and Preston Jordan Jr. We envision peaceful civilization across Earth, the Moon, and Mars.

Our work explores lunar infrastructure, Earth-space communications, satellites, AI, blockchain verification, quantum-resistant security, habitats, and sustainable food systems.

Through Lunar First Light, we turn space science into tools for exploration and education. We welcome scientists, engineers, and partners.
